Name: DRIJUICE's Swans for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from DRIJUICE, I've updated their Swans (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13151]here[/url]) to work with SVD 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to DRIJUICE.

Swans live in coops and produce down and eggs that can be turned into mayo. And yes, they can swim!

Enjoy!
